strategies.text:
Overview

Xurkitree solo without weather boost while using Zacian Crown's blade boost has only been completed against Power Whip. Maximizing energy gained from power-whip and strong tick perfect cast with quick switch timings are required to defeat this boss.

Est Time to Win [299.5s - 305s]

Main Strategy

Lead with Primal Groudon and DPS with Mud Shot, Precipice Blades.

1) When to face-tank Power Whip:

During the DPS period, Primal Groudon must tank and absorb maximum energy from power-whip which deals ~52 damage and grants ~26 energy. This means to absorb the full 26 energy, Groudon must be holding around:

  1. 0-50 energy (0-50% of the orb)
  2. 76-100 energy (76-100% of the orb)

If Primal Groudon is holding around 76-81 energy at the time of power-whip cast, TPC is required to gain the full 26 energy or else the power whip will land 1t before Precipice blades cast thus nulling any energy gain from it)

2) When to catch Tank Power Whip:

When Primal Groudon is holding between 50-76 energy, catch tank with a Shadow Groudon and combo with about 7 Mud Shots & 1 Precipice Blades before returning to Primal Groudon. Shadow Mamoswine is an alternative and preferred catch tank if it is available.

3) If it double Power Whips

If another power whip occurs, switch to another shadow Groudon to intercept and repeat. Back track your way to Primal Groudon afterwards as Power Whip can no longer be casted until the first precipice blades comes out. Be early that each Precipice blades is fueling Xurktree with 100. This means it is able to double powerwhip the moment a single precipice blades is cast.

4) Overall Bulk of Party, rejoin estimates, win rate estimate.

Each Shadow Groudon can tank up to 1 Power Whip. Primal Groudon can tank up to 3. This is a total of 9 power whips per party. Expect a comfortable 2 rejoins, however if there is unexpected aggression from Xurkitree, a 3rd rejoin may occur.

A successful run is about 1/10 chance with strong, 70%, TPC. (this means tick perfect casting 70% of your precipice blades)

Run Ending Mistakes:

  1. Dropping a Powerwhip
  2. Fainting and losing a precipice blades
  3. Excessive dodging (2-3 dodges in the run)
  4. Phantom rejoin bug or 2 rejoin delays.
  5. Failing to TPC at 70% rate.
  6. Slow Rejoins

vods.label: TTW: 300s (2.99 rejoins, 70-75% TPC, 1 10 atk & 4 15 atk Sh-Groudons)

strategies.strategyName: Mega Mewtwo Y and Double Catch Tank
strategies.text:
Overview

Mega Mewtwo Y is so strong that as a neutral damage attacker, Xurkitree can be taken out in Windy weather. It near rivals Primal Groudon's DPS but is half a step behind. Nevertheless, the advantage in being non-ground is the ability to absorb energy from electric type attacks offsetting its lesser innate DPS with higher energy gain increasing its actual DPS.

Est Time to Win: 285-295s (Local), 290-295s (Remote)

Main Strategy

Against Powerwhip, Dazzling Gleam

Double catch tank strategy with Shadow Regigigas by swapping Shadow Regigigas twice, the first swap quickly intercepts a powerwhip and dazzling gleam before retreating back to Mega Mewtwo Y. The second, (with the same Regigigas), intercepts another Power Whip/Dazzling Gleam and casts Crush Grip. Zen Headbutt is preferred here to gain the effects of windy weather boost unless hidden power ground is available.

If not available, Shadow Mamoswine is an excellent catch tanker for power whip allowing it to cast 1 mudslap then 1 high horsepower quickly.

Against Discharge

If Shadow Regigigas defense or level is low enough, it can double catch tank and absorb discharge energy. Not the most ideal answer but it can save a few rejoins.

Overview

This strategy revolves around recycling primal groudon in sunny weather. Shadow groudons may be used in case Primal Groudon isn't enough. TPC is helpful for retaining damage. The blade boost route is identical to the non blade boost route with a faster and more forgiving Time to win.

Est Time to Win: 260-270s (Remote) (250-265s Local)

Main Strategy

Against electric movesets, simply spam Precipice Blades and rejoin when unable to cast another precipice blades. Against Power Whip it is recommended to simply tank them or opt to catch tank with Landorus Therian or Shadow Groudon.

Overview

Xurkitree solo without weather boost while using Zacian Crown's blade boost has only been completed against Power Whip. Maximizing energy gained from power-whip and strong tick perfect cast with quick catch tank timings are required to defeat this boss. TPC is highly recommended for Primal Groudon damage.

Est Time to Win [298.0s - 300s]

Main Strategy

DPS with Primal Groudon making sure to absorb power whips (up to 3 power whips) while not allowing it to overflow in energy. Energy overflow occurs when Primal Groudon is holding roughly 50-76 energy (50-76% of the orb).

If this occurs, simply catch tank with Shadow Mamoswine for 1 mud-slap and 1 high horsepower.

Aim for roughly 3 rejoins with the rejoins on average occurring around the 225s, 150s and 75s mark. That being said pacing and RNG could mean faster or slower rejoins. That is okay as long as 2 rejoins are hit.

vods.label: TTW: 299.5s [Full Sized, Any/PW, TPC, Some Lag]
